personality_one_liner: A sharp, function-first, industrial-tech environment designed for an AI app-creator, emphasizing raw code capability over soft AI tropes.

spacing.rule: Rigid grids, hard alignment, intentional whitespace imbalance. Use thick borders structurally.

dont's: Do not use blur or glass. Brutalist personality forbids it. Use solid surfaceSecondary or brandTertiary.

screens.name: Auth (Login/Register)
screens.purpose: A stark, structural entry point that emphasizes the tool's raw utility.
screens.layout: Use edge-to-edge sections with thick structural borders. Huge 'js.AI' display typography at the top. Hard-edged inputs (2pt borderStrong on focus). A single strong Industrial Orange primary button at the bottom.

screens.name: Chat (Main)
screens.purpose: The core app-creation interface where the user chats with the AI agent.

states.empty: Massive 'js.AI' translucent mono typography watermark centered on the screen. A few rigid suggestion chips at the bottom.
states.error: Inline error block with 'Retry' mechanical button.

screens.layout: Left drawer hamburger menu top-left. Chat bubbles are hard rectangles (0 radius) - user bubbles in surfaceSecondary, AI bubbles in surface (no background) with border dividers. Input field is a rigid box pinned to bottom with safe-area. Use Space Mono for any generated code blocks with a dark surfaceTertiary background regardless of theme.

screens.name: Drawer Menu
screens.purpose: Left-side slide-in navigation for History, Settings, Theme, About, Language.
screens.layout: Full height overlay sliding from left. Hard right border (2pt). Huge structural headers. Navigation items are large text blocks. Include a theme toggle (switch or text flip) and list of past chat sessions.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Configure the tool's environment (Theme, Language, Account).
screens.layout: List of configuration rows with exposed system states (visible toggles, mono labels). Segmented controls for Light/Dark mode with sharp borders.

drawer_hero_bg.alt: Abstract orange and black graphic texture for drawer header

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a Brutalist Mobile interface (Personality 5). All borders and corners must be sharp (radius 0). Do not use rounded corners anywhere.
Implement the 'js.AI' watermark prominently in the center of the empty chat state. Use oversized Space Mono typography with low opacity or the provided watermark image.
Do not use generic AI purple/violet gradients. The color palette is stark monochrome with an Industrial Orange (brand) accent.
The primary navigation MUST be a left-side drawer as requested ('menú desplegable al lado izquierdo'). Do not implement bottom tabs.
Ensure chat bubbles have no border radius. User bubbles should be solid surfaceSecondary; AI bubbles can just be text on the main surface with an industrial border separator.
Any code blocks generated by the AI must use Space Mono font and be styled distinctively from normal text (e.g., surfaceTertiary background).
Implement real-time streaming text effects for AI responses to make it feel like a terminal/builder environment.
Include Theme (light/dark) toggle in the drawer menu as explicitly requested.
